films.title: Intro
films.summary: A guided overview: editable use cases, a voiced character, force fields, glyph fills, connected particles, graphic shadows and spatial lettering, art direction, Spark / Form and mechanical inspection, then a one-line edit rendered to MP4.

card.headline: Intro
card.description: Use cases, character performance, art direction, a complete title story, mechanical assembly and cutaway, then an edit rendered to MP4.
card.useFor: Seeing what the repository makes before choosing an example.
card.relation: It repeats selected use cases and effects; each has its own film below.

films.audience: First-time visitors deciding whether the repository fits their work.

films.title: Every Stroke Is Code
films.summary: Over 1,000 stroke-sliced Latin and CJK vectors swarm into a Bento mural, invert polarity from one expanding dot and loop seamlessly.

card.headline: Every Stroke Is Code
card.description: Over 1,000 stroke-sliced Latin and CJK vectors assemble a multi-angle Bento mural, invert polarity from a single dot and close a seamless loop.
card.useFor: Launch reels, kinetic-typography manifestos and developer tool announcements.
card.relation: Combines the stroke-swarm Bento mural and the off-center dot-iris polarity wipe; frame 0 and frame 720 meet on the same period dot.

films.audience: Design engineers and brand teams making high-craft kinetic typography.

films.title: Liquid Mercury Type
films.summary: A top-down studio raymarcher pours liquid mercury into Latin and CJK letterforms, settles with specular glints and melts cleanly back into the cyclorama.

card.headline: Liquid Mercury Type
card.description: Liquid metal beads nucleate, coalesce into sculpted Latin and CJK chrome lettering under studio softboxes, then melt away into a seamless loop.
card.useFor: Luxury title cards, album visuals and tactile brand stings.
card.relation: Runs the 16-bit Euclidean distance-field raymarcher across two word cycles; custom strings work via ?text=.

films.audience: Art directors and motion designers crafting tactile 3D lettering without offline DCC bakes.

card.headline: Spark / Form

card.useFor: Title sequences, technical identities and brand openers.
card.relation: A finished combination of lettering, surface hatching and authored drawing/camera transitions; not additional effect families.

films.audience: Designers making precise, cinematic title sequences.
